streams.name: Physics
streams.discipline: Physical Science (Forces, Motion, Energy, Light, Sound, Electricity)

concepts.title: Push & Pull (Forces)
concepts.summary: Forces make things start, stop, or change direction.

concepts.title: Fast & Slow (Speed)
concepts.summary: How quickly things move.

concepts.title: Gravity
concepts.summary: Things fall down toward Earth.

concepts.title: Friction
concepts.summary: Rough surfaces slow things; smooth ones let them slide.

concepts.title: Magnets: Attract & Repel
concepts.summary: Poles pull together or push apart.

concepts.title: Magnetic vs Non-Magnetic
concepts.summary: Only some materials stick to magnets.

concepts.title: Balanced & Unbalanced Forces
concepts.summary: Equal forces keep things still; unequal forces cause motion.

concepts.title: Lever (Simple Machine)
concepts.summary: A bar that lifts heavy loads with less effort.

concepts.title: Ramp / Inclined Plane
concepts.summary: Slopes make lifting easier.

concepts.title: Pulley & Wheel
concepts.summary: Wheels and ropes reduce the effort to move loads.

concepts.title: Floating & Sinking (Buoyancy)
concepts.summary: Why boats float and rocks sink.

concepts.title: Light Travels in Straight Lines
concepts.summary: Light moves straight until something blocks it.

concepts.title: Shadows
concepts.summary: Made when an object blocks light.

concepts.title: Reflection & Mirrors
concepts.summary: Light bounces off shiny surfaces so we can see.

concepts.title: Light & Color / Rainbows
concepts.summary: White light splits into many colors.

concepts.title: Sound from Vibrations
concepts.summary: Vibrating objects make sound.

concepts.title: Pitch & Volume
concepts.summary: High/low and loud/soft sounds.

concepts.title: How Sound Travels & We Hear
concepts.summary: Sound moves through air to our ears.

concepts.title: Forms of Energy
concepts.summary: Light, heat, sound, and motion are all energy.

concepts.title: Heat & Temperature
concepts.summary: Hot vs cold, and how heat moves around.

concepts.title: Simple Circuits
concepts.summary: A complete loop that lights a bulb.

concepts.title: Conductors & Insulators
concepts.summary: What lets electricity through and what blocks it.

concepts.title: Static Electricity
concepts.summary: Charges that make hair stand up and balloons stick.

concepts.title: Collisions & Motion Transfer
concepts.summary: Moving things pass on their motion when they hit.

concepts.title: Stored vs Moving Energy
concepts.summary: Potential (stored) vs kinetic (moving) energy.

concepts.title: Newton's Second Law (F = ma)
concepts.summary: Acceleration depends on the net force and the object's mass: a = F ÷ m. More force speeds things up faster; more mass resists the change.

concepts.title: Energy Conservation (KE ↔ PE)
concepts.summary: Energy is conserved — it changes between potential (height) and kinetic (motion) but the total stays the same. To clear a hill you need at least its height stored as potential energy at the start.

concepts.title: Momentum & Collisions
concepts.summary: Momentum (mass × velocity) is conserved in a collision. When objects stick together, the combined speed is (mA·vA + mB·vB) ÷ (mA + mB).

concepts.title: Heat Transfer & Insulation
concepts.summary: Heat flows from hot to cold until temperatures even out. Insulation slows that flow, so a hot object stays warm longer.

concepts.title: Gravity & Orbits
concepts.summary: Gravity pulls a satellite toward a planet; if it moves sideways fast enough it keeps 'missing' and orbits. The circular-orbit speed is v = √(GM ÷ r).

concepts.title: Net Force (action–reaction)
concepts.summary: Forces come in equal, opposite pairs, but motion is set by the NET force — the difference between opposing pushes. Equal forces balance to no motion.

concepts.title: Properties of Objects
concepts.summary: Color, shape, size, and texture describe objects.

concepts.title: Solids, Liquids, Gases
concepts.summary: The three everyday states of matter.

concepts.title: Melting
concepts.summary: Solid turns to liquid with heat.

concepts.title: Freezing
concepts.summary: Liquid turns to solid with cold.

concepts.title: Evaporation
concepts.summary: Liquid turns to gas.

concepts.title: Condensation
concepts.summary: Gas turns back to liquid (dew on a glass).

concepts.title: Heating & Cooling Change Matter
concepts.summary: Temperature changes the state of matter.

concepts.title: Reversible Changes
concepts.summary: Melting and freezing can be undone.

concepts.title: Irreversible Changes
concepts.summary: Cooking and burning create something new.

concepts.title: Mixtures
concepts.summary: Combining materials without changing them.

concepts.title: Dissolving (Solutions)
concepts.summary: Sugar and salt seem to disappear into water.

concepts.title: Separating Mixtures
concepts.summary: Sieving, filtering, and magnets pull mixtures apart.

concepts.title: Materials & Their Uses
concepts.summary: Wood, metal, plastic, and glass each suit different jobs.

concepts.title: Natural vs Man-Made Materials
concepts.summary: Where materials come from.

concepts.title: Material Properties
concepts.summary: Hardness, flexibility, and transparency.

concepts.title: Sorting Materials by Property
concepts.summary: Grouping things by what they are like.

concepts.title: Crystals
concepts.summary: Salt and sugar form repeating shapes.

concepts.title: Conservation of Matter
concepts.summary: Mass stays the same even when shape changes.

concepts.title: Matter is Made of Tiny Bits
concepts.summary: Matter is made of particles too small to see.

concepts.title: Absorbency
concepts.summary: Which materials soak up water.

concepts.title: Waterproof Materials
concepts.summary: Materials that keep water out.

concepts.title: Everyday Acids & Bases
concepts.summary: Sour lemon vs slippery soap (gentle intro).

concepts.title: Rusting & Tarnishing
concepts.summary: Slow changes to metals over time.

concepts.title: Mixing Colors
concepts.summary: Paints combine to make new colors.

concepts.title: Recycling & Reusing Materials
concepts.summary: Materials can be given a second life.

concepts.title: Atomic Structure
concepts.summary: An atom is protons and neutrons in a nucleus with electrons around it. The proton count decides the element, neutrons set the mass, and matching electrons keep it neutral.

concepts.title: Conservation of Mass
concepts.summary: Atoms are never created or destroyed in a reaction — only rearranged. A balanced equation has the same number of each atom on both sides.

concepts.title: Particle Motion & States
concepts.summary: Heat gives particles energy: cold locks them into a solid, warmth lets them flow as a liquid, and more heat sends them flying as a gas.

concepts.title: Acids, Bases & pH
concepts.summary: pH measures how acidic or basic a solution is — below 7 acidic, 7 neutral, above 7 basic. Mixing an acid and a base neutralizes toward 7.

concepts.title: Gas Behaviour (Ideal Gas Law)
concepts.summary: Gas pressure comes from particles hitting the walls. Heating speeds them up and shrinking the volume packs the hits closer — both raise pressure (P = nRT ÷ V).

concepts.title: Living vs Non-Living
concepts.summary: What counts as alive.

concepts.title: Basic Needs of Living Things
concepts.summary: Food, water, air, and space.

concepts.title: What Plants Need
concepts.summary: Water, sunlight, air, and soil.

concepts.title: Parts of a Plant
concepts.summary: Root, stem, leaf, and flower.

concepts.title: Plant Life Cycle
concepts.summary: Seed to seedling to plant.

concepts.title: Seed Dispersal
concepts.summary: How seeds travel to new places.

concepts.title: Photosynthesis (Basic)
concepts.summary: Plants make food from sunlight, air, and water.

concepts.title: Parts of the Human Body
concepts.summary: Major external and internal body parts.

concepts.title: The Five Senses
concepts.summary: Sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch.

concepts.title: Animal Life Cycles
concepts.summary: Metamorphosis of butterflies and frogs.

concepts.title: Animal Groups
concepts.summary: Mammals, birds, fish, reptiles, amphibians, insects.

concepts.title: Herbivores, Carnivores, Omnivores
concepts.summary: What different animals eat.

concepts.title: Food Chains
concepts.summary: Who eats whom in a sequence.

concepts.title: Food Webs & Energy Flow
concepts.summary: Connected food chains across an ecosystem.

concepts.title: Habitats
concepts.summary: Where animals live and why.

concepts.title: Adaptations
concepts.summary: Features that help animals survive their environment.

concepts.title: Camouflage
concepts.summary: Blending in to hide from predators or prey.

concepts.title: Inherited Traits
concepts.summary: Offspring resemble their parents.

concepts.title: Variation Among Living Things
concepts.summary: Differences within the same kind of organism.

concepts.title: Migration & Hibernation
concepts.summary: Seasonal survival behaviors.

concepts.title: Decomposers & Decay
concepts.summary: Nature's recyclers break down dead matter.

concepts.title: The Skeleton & Bones
concepts.summary: The framework that holds the body up.

concepts.title: Teeth & Digestion (Basic)
concepts.summary: How the body breaks down food.

concepts.title: Microorganisms / Germs
concepts.summary: Tiny living things, some helpful and some harmful (beyond strict NGSS K-5).

concepts.title: Ecosystems & Interdependence
concepts.summary: Living things depend on each other to survive.

concepts.title: Weather
concepts.summary: Sunny, rainy, windy, and cloudy days.

concepts.title: Seasons
concepts.summary: Spring, summer, fall, and winter.

concepts.title: Day & Night
concepts.summary: Earth spins on its axis.

concepts.title: The Sun: Light & Heat
concepts.summary: Our nearest star warms the Earth.

concepts.title: The Moon & Its Phases
concepts.summary: Why the Moon appears to change shape.

concepts.title: Stars & Constellations
concepts.summary: Patterns of stars in the night sky.

concepts.title: Sun-Earth-Moon System
concepts.summary: How the three move in relation to each other.

concepts.title: The Solar System & Planets
concepts.summary: Planets orbiting the Sun (extends toward MS scope).

concepts.title: Why Seasons Happen (Tilt)
concepts.summary: Earth's tilt causes the seasons (gentle intro).

concepts.title: The Water Cycle
concepts.summary: Evaporation, condensation, and precipitation loop.

concepts.title: Clouds & Precipitation
concepts.summary: How rain, snow, and hail form.

concepts.title: Bodies of Water
concepts.summary: Oceans, rivers, and lakes.

concepts.title: Landforms
concepts.summary: Mountains, valleys, and plains.

concepts.title: Rocks & Minerals
concepts.summary: Different types of rock and how we use them.

concepts.title: Soil
concepts.summary: How soil forms and its layers.

concepts.title: Weathering & Erosion
concepts.summary: How wind and water slowly reshape the land.

concepts.title: Volcanoes
concepts.summary: How and why volcanoes erupt.

concepts.title: Earthquakes
concepts.summary: Why the ground shakes.

concepts.title: Fossils
concepts.summary: Clues that tell us about life long ago.

concepts.title: Natural Resources
concepts.summary: Water, air, minerals, and fuels we depend on.

concepts.title: Renewable vs Non-Renewable
concepts.summary: Resources that run out, and ones that don't.

concepts.title: Conservation
concepts.summary: Protecting our environment and resources.

concepts.title: Maps & Earth's Surface
concepts.summary: Representing places and features.

concepts.title: Climate vs Weather
concepts.summary: Long-term climate vs day-to-day weather.

concepts.title: Natural Hazards & Safety
concepts.summary: Storms and floods, and how to stay safe.

concepts.title: Greenhouse Effect & Climate
concepts.summary: Greenhouse gases like CO₂ trap heat like a blanket, so more CO₂ warms the planet and less lets it cool. That's the greenhouse effect that sets Earth's temperature.

concepts.title: Life Cycle of Stars
concepts.summary: A star's mass decides its fate: low-mass stars fade into white dwarfs, while heavy stars explode as supernovae and leave behind neutron stars or black holes.

concepts.title: Plate Tectonics & Boundaries
concepts.summary: Moving plates shape the crust: convergent boundaries push it up into mountains or down into trenches, divergent boundaries pull it apart into ridges and valleys.

concepts.title: The Rock Cycle
concepts.summary: Earth recycles rock through cooling, weathering, compacting, heat & pressure, and melting — turning igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rock into one another.

concepts.title: Weather Systems
concepts.summary: Temperature and moisture make the weather: dry air is sunny, moist air clouds and rains, and warm, very moist air builds into thunderstorms.
